content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes asphalt plants and aggregate and mining machinery for road builders, a different business from Weatherford's oilfield tools and services."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Makes wellheads and pressure control equipment and runs well-site crews for oil and gas producers, closely matching Weatherford's well completion and intervention work."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Builds roads and bridges for public owners and sells asphalt and concrete, unrelated to oil and gas well services."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Distributes MRO supplies and repairs pumps for industrial plants, not oilfield drilling or completion tools for operators."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Distributes plumbing, HVAC and waterworks products to contractors, a different business from Weatherford's oilfield services."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Performs public infrastructure construction and produces aggregates and asphalt, unlike Weatherford's oil and gas well services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Diversified industrial maker of pumps, brake friction parts and connectors, serving many end markets rather than well services."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures pre-insulated piping for district energy and industrial projects, not downhole or wellsite equipment and services."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Mines frac sand and provides proppant logistics, a supply input to fracturing rather than Weatherford's tools and well services."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Provides inspection, repair and heat treating for refinery and plant assets, a different service line from well construction and production."}]}
